title: Fervor Armor
wikitext:
{{/Infobox}} '''Fervor Armor''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Armor]] set. There are 4 upgraded tiers of Fervor Armor: '''Hot''', '''Burning''', '''Fiery''', and '''Infernal''', which can all be obtained by prestiging the previous tier. == Obtaining == Basic Tier '''Fervor Armor''' Pieces can be obtained from [[Kuudra#Reward Chests|Paid Reward Chests]] at the end of a [[Kuudra]] fight. ;Piece Drop Chances *Basic Tier: {{Green|4.31%}} *Hot Tier: {{Green|4.27%}} *Burning Tier: {{Green|4.18%}} *Fiery Tier: {{Green|4.1%}} *Infernal Tier: {{Green|4.01%}} Higher tiers of '''Fervor Armor''' can be obtained by prestiging the previous tier at a blacksmith ({{NPCSprite|Malik}}, {{NPCSprite|Igor}}, {{NPCSprite|Alwin}}, or [[The Hex]]), which can be done if it has 10 [[Star Upgrades|Stars]] applied to it.
